segments.sn48.1:1.5: Saddhindriyaṃ, vīriyindriyaṃ, satindriyaṃ, samādhindriyaṃ, paññindriyaṃ – imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañcindriyānī”ti.

lines: Indriyasaṃyuttassa paṭhame saddhindriyaṃ satindriyaṃ paññindriyanti imāni tīṇi catubhūmakakusalavipākesu ceva kiriyāsu ca labbhanti.
Vīriyindriyasamādhindriyāni catubhūmakakusale akusale vipāke kiriyāyāti sabbattha labbhanti.
Catubhūmaka … pe … labbhanti kusalābyākatabhāvato tesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ indriyānaṃ.
Catubhūmaka … pe … vasenāti catubhūmakadhammaparicchedavasena ceva kusalādīhi sabbasaṅgāhakadhammaparicchedavasena ca vuttanti attho.
